blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Visayas Grid will be placed under red and yellow alerts on Monday, Nov. 23, the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) said. In an advisory, the NGCP said the Visayas Grid would first be placed under a yellow alert from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m., before transitioning to a red alert from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. Another yellow alert would be implemented immediately afterward and would last until 8 p.m. According to the NGCP, a red alert is issued when power supply is insufficient to meet consumer demand and the grid’s regulating requirement.
